definition: to make a deep loud sound
description: At a night festival a man with his hair in a bun, in a dark short coat and trousers, stands in a wide lunge on a wet wooden stage and strikes the skin of a giant drum on a red stand with a thick wooden stick, so that dust and spray fly off the drumhead. He swings the stick high over his head, hits the drum again and shouts. Paper lanterns glow on a string above, a wooden shrine gate stands in the smoke behind, and spectators crowd the edge of the stage.
